'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Daniel Thorson DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Daniel Thorson]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Miner's Guild
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
